summary: Max Verstappen converted pole position into his and Red Bull's first win of the season, pulling clear despite a software glitch that forced a chaotic restart and left both him and Lewis Hamilton comparing the conditions to driving a "Lego race." Russell's retirement and Hamilton's recovery drive proved unable to challenge Verstappen's pace through the heat-hazard conditions in Malaysia. The victory extends Verstappen's championship lead as Red Bull's new upgrade package demonstrates decisive performance gains heading into the season's crucial phase.
